dedupe_keys.name: synconn build synthetic building operation generator

description: The synconn_build repository publishes a Python generator for control-oriented building-operation datasets. Its README describes taking a configurable EnergyPlus building template, producing stochastic control signals and occupancy schedules, obtaining weather inputs, running simulations and writing outputs for training or testing neural models of building dynamics. The public tree includes configuration YAML, generator code, EnergyPlus templates, weather examples and a small sample output directory. Repository metadata states MIT for the generator; the EnergyPlus engine and external weather files retain their own terms. Coverage depends on the building templates and weather locations users choose; the repository tree shows only a small sample output. The README describes an EnergyPlus 22.1 installation and Windows-style configuration paths, so portability to another installation was not verified. No simulation was run and no output CSV rows were inspected. Simulation use includes generating controlled counterfactual sequences for HVAC model calibration or comparing prediction methods under varied schedules. It complements data-climate-onebuilding-tmyx-weather-files because the generator can consume such weather inputs but creates synthetic building operations, not measured weather. A caveat is that outputs depend on the chosen building template, control signals and weather and must not be treated as observed building demand.
